ca_01_status: unresolved (specific Multicall3 registration fixed; forged adapter readiness remains)

findings.title: Arbitrary registered adapters can forge freeze readiness
findings.requirement: Adapter freeze readiness must not be forgeable or practically bypassable; a frozen executor must not permanently bless an arbitrary mutable adapter.
findings.evidence: registerAdapter rejects only zero and the canonical Multicall3 address, then accepts every other address. freezeConfiguration trusts the attacker-selected contract's configurationFrozen() boolean without validating a reviewed implementation, factory, code hash, proxy status, immutable configuration, or meaningful freeze semantics. The repository's MockAdapter demonstrates the flaw: configurationFrozen defaults true while setFrozen, setMode, and setRatio remain callable, and the executor test freezes around that still-mutable adapter.
findings.reproduction: Deploy an IAdapter whose configurationFrozen() returns true and whose swap behavior remains mutable (or use an upgradeable proxy). Register it, call SweepExecutor.freezeConfiguration successfully, mutate/upgrade the adapter afterward, and execute a signed plan through the still-allowed address.
findings.consequence: The executor's frozen state does not establish an immutable reviewed execution boundary. Arbitrary adapter behavior can remain reachable permanently, so CA-01's freeze-bypass component remains exploitable in the practical way the re-audit rules classify as P1.
findings.remediation: Constrain registration to authenticated, non-upgradeable reviewed adapter implementations/instances (for example immutable typed slots or approved code hashes plus constructor/immutable validation), and verify meaningful frozen state only after identity is established.
findings.regression_test_required: An unknown mutable adapter and an upgradeable/forged-true adapter must be rejected at registration or block freeze; only canonical reviewed Pancake/Uniswap instances may freeze the executor, and their post-freeze configuration must be immutable.

findings.title: Freeze readiness remains incomplete and is tested only through a weak mock proxy
findings.requirement: Empty/invalid configuration must not accidentally freeze unless explicitly intended, and real unfrozen Pancake and Uniswap adapters must each block executor freeze.
findings.evidence: freezeConfiguration succeeds with zero active adapters and no readiness definition beyond self-reported booleans. The four claimed CA-01 tests use MockAdapter; no integration test registers an unfrozen PancakeV2Adapter or UniswapV3Adapter and proves each blocks executor freeze. Of the four tests, only the explicit Multicall3-revert test and unfrozen-mock test would fail on the pre-fix implementation; the all-frozen-success and removed-adapter-success tests already pass under the old unconditional freeze behavior.
findings.reproduction: Immediately freeze a newly deployed executor: it succeeds. Search the test suite for executor freeze with real PancakeV2Adapter/UniswapV3Adapter: no such readiness test exists.
findings.consequence: Invalid deployments can be irreversibly frozen, and the claimed regression set proves a weaker property than the required real-adapter lifecycle.
findings.remediation: Define/enforce a valid production configuration and add executor-level lifecycle tests using both production adapter classes.
findings.regression_test_required: Empty/invalid freeze follows an explicitly documented policy; unfrozen Pancake and Uniswap each block; both frozen permit; all later executor and adapter mutations revert.

findings.title: Unbounded historical adapter enumeration can make freeze exceed the block gas limit
findings.requirement: Adapter enumeration must be consistent, bounded, and capable of completing freeze within practical gas limits.
findings.evidence: _registeredAdapterList retains every unique address ever registered. removeAdapter only clears allowedAdapters and never removes the historical entry. freezeConfiguration iterates the entire unbounded history, including checking and skipping removed entries.
findings.reproduction: As owner, repeatedly register and remove unique addresses, then estimate/call freezeConfiguration after the historical list is large enough to exceed Monad's transaction block-gas allowance.
findings.consequence: A compromised or erroneous administrative sequence can permanently prevent the intended trust-boundary transition even after all malicious adapters are removed.
findings.remediation: Use a bounded active enumerable set, delete removed entries, and/or enforce a small maximum adapter count appropriate to the supported typed adapters.
findings.regression_test_required: Bounded maximum/active-set removal tests plus a worst-case freeze gas assertion below the deployment chain limit.

findings.title: Remediation summaries still miscount the nine prior P2/P3 findings as eight
findings.requirement: Finding totals and remediation mapping must match CA-02 through CA-10.
findings.evidence: PROJECT_STATUS.md says 'eight P2/P3 findings'; artifacts/security-addendum/findings.md lines 64-74 repeats eight while discussing CA-02 through CA-10, which is nine findings.
findings.reproduction: Count the inclusive identifiers CA-02..CA-10 and compare the remediation text.
findings.consequence: CA-10's count-consistency remediation is itself incomplete and the closure accounting remains unreliable.
findings.remediation: Change the count to nine and preserve a one-to-one CA-02 through CA-10 mapping.

findings.title: Stale absolute no-Multicall claims remain in historical status/evidence sections
findings.requirement: Documentation must not retain false absolute claims that no Multicall3 references existed when the named test already contained them.
findings.evidence: PROJECT_STATUS.md lines 498-500 still says no Multicall3 reference existed anywhere, then names the Multicall3 test at line 525. artifacts/security-addendum/findings.md line 12 retains the same false absolute assertion. Later appended corrections accurately classify matches but do not mark these statements as retracted/incorrect.
findings.reproduction: Compare the stale statements with packages/contracts/test/SweepExecutor.t.sol's original named test and the later correction sections.
findings.consequence: The documentation remains internally contradictory even though the primary grep evidence was corrected.
findings.remediation: Mark the old assertions explicitly as superseded/incorrect or rewrite them to distinguish production-source matches from test references.
findings.regression_test_required: Repository documentation search for unqualified no-match claims after evidence updates.
